chunks.title: ThingsX (Part-Time Contract)
chunks.text: Brian worked at ThingsX as Application Security Engineer / Full-Stack Engineer (Jun 2026 - Present). ThingsX (Part-Time Contract). Application Security Engineer / Full-Stack Engineer Own features end to end on a production multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform (TypeScript, Deno, PostgreSQL, React, REST APIs), from schema migration through the API layer to the operator-facing UI. Deliver frontend and UX work across the dashboard and reporting console: sortable data tables, chart rendering and label-overlap fixes, report filter behavior, account status displays, and role/session state handling. Remediated 50+ production vulnerabilities across access-control, injection, and race-condition classes, including a cross-tenant authorization gap fixed by moving privileged-function authorization server-side onto session auth, proved by reproducing the exploit in reverse and regression-tested so the entire bug class fails the build. Built a 13-stage, one-command CI/CD pipeline enforced by a pre-push git hook (typecheck, builds, unit tests, negative Row-Level Security probes, data-integrity invariants), and eliminated a job-queue data-loss bug with exactly-once TOCTOU guards, verified under 20-way parallel load.

chunks.title: United Micro Technology
chunks.text: Brian worked at United Micro Technology as LLVM Compiler Intern (May 2025 - Aug 2025). United Micro Technology. LLVM Compiler Intern Implemented instruction selection rules, register allocation paths, and lowering strategies in the LLVM C++ backend, and assessed vector instruction extensions for NPU-integrated workloads. Enabled accurate early-stage architectural modeling by translating ISA specifications into processor description files. Delivered the technical report on backend design tradeoffs steering future vDSP ASIP compiler work.

chunks.title: United Micro Technology
chunks.text: Brian worked at United Micro Technology as Software Engineering Intern (Jun 2024 - Aug 2024). United Micro Technology. Software Engineering Intern Built a Python ingestion system that normalized third-party vendor register descriptions into the company's internal SystemRDL representation, cutting the effort to onboard externally acquired IP by an estimated 60-70%. Extended the open-source SystemRDL toolchain with custom Jinja2-templated exporters emitting synthesizable RTL, C headers, and documentation directly in the company's internal file structure, and embedded the CLI in the production chip design flow. Packaged the tool with Poetry for reproducible installs and shipped it to 200+ engineers who used it daily for register development, verification prep, and documentation.

chunks.title: Axle - Personal Project
chunks.text: Brian built Axle (Jan 2026 - Present). Axle - Personal Project. Creator and Full-Stack Developer (React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, REST APIs) Built and own an AI-powered used-car platform end to end as sole author: React/Vite frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, and auth, from TAMUhack prototype to deployed product (d1j3m9qdbgs5ik.cloudfront.net). Converted free-form user input into validated structured JSON via an LLM pipeline (OpenRouter) with schema sanitization, a 40-entry feature-alias map, fuzzy matching, and two-tier model routing with automatic failover. Designed a 10-level progressive constraint-relaxation algorithm over a weighted scoring engine so the system returns ranked, relevant matches even when no listing satisfies every criterion. Held API usage within a 1,000-call/month free tier via multi-tier caching across memory, disk, and AWS DynamoDB (NoSQL, TTL-expiring), deployed serverless on AWS Lambda and API Gateway with a CloudFront/S3 frontend.
